individualService.title: Individual Service
individualService.description: If you know what your car needs, choose each service individually. From maintenance and repair to cleaning, you can flexibly select services according to your needs without paying extra for unnecessary items.

comboService.title: Combo Service Package
comboService.description: If you are not knowledgeable about cars or simply want to save time, all-inclusive service packages are the optimal choice. Each combo is pre-designed, including essential items to ensure your car is always in top condition, giving you peace of mind.
